description: Add audience segments (e.g. past buyers) as EXCLUDE targeting on an ad squad, keeping existing targeting. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_exclude_segments
